_comment: Platinum's story bosses in play order, each in the split Ian's Level Caps sheet puts it in (My Version RomHack Docs, sheet Level Caps, read 2026-09-22), except that the Galactic fights moved on Ian's rulings of 2026-09-25: Cyrus 2 and Saturn 2 to the HQ split, and Mars and Jupiter at Spear Pillar and Cyrus 3 to the Galactic split. Trainers are Platinum trainer constants, which are also the tr_id every Platinum-based hack's calculator data uses. A rival fight lists all three starter variants; a tag battle lists both opponents. sheet_ace is the sheet's level for the boss's strongest Pokemon, null where the sheet has no row. Tag-battle partners (Cheryl, Mira, Riley, Marley, Buck, Lucas, Dawn, Barry at Spear Pillar) fight beside the player and are not bosses.

caps._comment: Ian's hard caps. Roark to Candice and the League from his Level Caps sheet (Maylene 39, which he confirmed on 2026-09-22); HQ 60, Galactic 65 and Volkner 68 from his Battle Zone rulings of 2026-09-25, set ahead of the trainers, which the trainer pass brings up to them. The level-cap design may move any of them.

overrides._comment: Where a Platinum-based hack keeps a fight under a different trainer id than Platinum's, fight key to the ids it really uses. Found by comparing names and levels across the hacks' data (2026-09-22), not from their scripts.

redux._note: Redux swapped the two Galactic HQ slots. Its League is at level 100 in several sets (787 to 791, 866 to 870, 874 to 883); 787 to 791 are taken as the first run and the rest as rematches. Unverified until Redux's scripts or docs confirm it.

kaizo._note: Kaizo's League is at level 100 in Platinum's rematch slots, after an 84 Volkner; the first-fight slots hold vanilla's unchanged sets.

milestones._comment: Hacks built on other games line up by position: their Nth gym leader against Oxide's Nth gym fight, their Elite Four in order against Aaron, Bertha, Flint and Lucian, their Champion against Cynthia. ids are the hack's trainer ids, or trainer names where its data has none. A fight the hack has not rebalanced is left out rather than compared. Checked by hand against levels, classes and locations on 2026-09-22.

hardlove._note: Read from the donor ROM, Hardlove 0.6.9. Chuck (47) comes before Jasmine (54) and Pryce (66). The ROM's League is Will, Koga, Karen and Lance as the Elite Four (Lance has the Elite Four class) with Blue (class Champion) as Champion; both of Bruno's slots hold Zubat placeholders. Ian confirmed this League on 2026-09-22.

null._note: Emerald order. Tate and Liza are a tag fight (794, 795) in the Mossdeep Gym. The eighth gym is Ex Leader Juan (272, level 97), as Ian confirmed on 2026-09-22; Leader Steven (804) in the same gym is not the gym fight. The Elite Four's singles sets are used; the rival replaces Glacia.

unbound._note: Difficult mode, bosses only, keyed by name.

run_and_bun._note: From Ian's sheet, keyed by name. Run & Bun's gym order is Brawly, Roxanne, Wattson, Norman, Flannery, Winona, Tate and Liza, Juan, the sheet's tab order. Flannery and Juan are double battles; Tate and Liza are one fight. The Elite Four's singles sets are used.
